name: heat shock protein 90 alpha family class A member 1
pathways: positive regulation of telomere maintenance via telomerase

function.text: HSP90AA1 encodes heat shock protein HSP 90-alpha. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and enzyme-substrate adaptor activity. It participates in telomere maintenance via telomerase and positive regulation of telomere maintenance via telomerase.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
